unit: Second researcher reconstruction of the same sourced decision; not an independent project or historical trajectory.

source.locator: Furniture description: lightweight sofa; Multiple Purposes for Multiple Uses
source.paraphrase: Movable furniture lets the shared room accommodate changing activities.

conditions.source: Compact shared living/dining/studio room with movable sofa and table plus folding bed.
conditions.researcher_adaptation: Move the same sofa and two stool proxies through nine prospectively fixed native actions, retaining instances; compare floor release and effects on other approach locations.

reconstruction.object_identity_origin: researcher instances; not source requirement to retain old furniture
reconstruction.scope: Main-room reconstruction only; not full38m2 home or physical activity demonstration.

action.planned_coordinates_origin: researcher constructed; source does not contain these waypoints

outcome.cost: Bookcase and right-window approaches lost; original fixed diagnostics not all restored.
outcome.label: mixed; no whole-room preference supported
unknowns: Still loses bookcase and right-window approach samples; left-window samples retained.
V1/V2 comparison is descriptive: both input repair and editable object set changed. Not a controlled A/B or independent project.
Square bodies, AABB routing and assumed fronts do not establish human handling, ergonomics, daylight or furniture operation.
No folded-bed articulation or whole dwelling replay. All main-room dimensions are assumptions; V1 dimension sensitivity is retained, not a V2 robustness test.
No human professional preference, positive training admission or learning/generalization claim.

rights: Use of source images or verbatim text for training not established; only attributed brief paraphrase and our own generated evidence published. HSSD resources remain server-resident under their original terms.
